opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search with guests, filters and sorting
opportunities.description: Search Kayak hotels for a {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out}, set the {guest_count}, apply optional filters ({filters}) and sort by {sort_order}.
steps: Click 'Search for hotels'
Type the destination into the location box and pick the matching suggestion
Pick the check-in and check-out dates in the calendar
Open 'Number of rooms and guests' and click Increment until the guest count is right, then Update
Click Search
Apply filters if needed (rating, free internet, style, amenities)
Sort results (Distance and/or Price low to high)

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; check-in 27, check-out 2; 2 guests added; sorted by Distance, then Price low to high
Santa Fe, NM; dates 16–18; 2 guests added
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; dates 6–10; 3 guests added
Los Angeles; dates 21–23; 7 guests; filters: rating 8+, free internet, Family style, air-conditioned; sorted by Distance, then Price low to high

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On Qatar Airways, search flights from {origin} to {destination} departing {depart_date} with {passengers} in {cabin_class}, then pick a fare.
steps: Type the origin into 'From' and pick the suggestion
Type the destination into 'To' and pick the suggestion
Open the depart date picker and pick the date
Continue, then open 'Passengers / Class'
Adjust adult, child and infant counts and pick the cabin class, then Confirm
Click 'Show flights'
Click a fare price heading and click 'Select fare' (for each leg)

instances.values: Colombo → New York; depart 24 June 2023; +1 child; Business/First; picked LKR 1,120,521 and LKR 3,125,932 fares
Doha → Durban (picked from Explore/Discover); depart 28 May 2023; +1 infant; picked QAR 4,980 fare

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel search
opportunities.description: Under Book > Hotels on Qatar Airways, search hotels in {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out} for {guests}, then sort or filter the results and open a hotel's availability.
steps: Click 'Book' and then 'Hotels'
Type the destination and pick the suggestion
Pick the check-in and check-out dates
Click Search
Adjust guests and rooms if needed, then Done
Sort by Price (lowest first) or apply filters
Open a hotel with 'See availability' and Reserve

instances.values: Las Vegas, NV; 10–16 April 2023; sorted by Price (lowest first)
Washington DC; 25 May–5 June 2023; guests adjusted; filters applied; See availability, then Reserve
